page.overview:
Who is Ran'jit?

Ran'jit is a tertiary antagonist in Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers. He is the general of the Eulmoran army on the First.

Ran'jit's father, Zal'bard, was the leader of a brotherhood of zealous assassins who trained their offspring in torturous ways and controlled "forbidden foreign magicks". While Zal'bard was visiting Eulmore's mayor, the the Flood of Light began, and Zal'bard and his group became permanent residents of Eulmore, acting as one of the first lines of defense against the sin eaters that spread from the Light-blasted areas of the Empty. Zal'bard then served as a general in Eulmore and fathered Ran'jit to pass on his techniques and magicks, training the young boy to summon his familiar, Gukumatz.

At a young age, Ran'jit trained alongside the first Minfilia of the First, under the tutelage of Zal'bard. Ran'jit was still a boy when his father formed an elite, anti-sin eater unit, known as the Sinbound. Working alongside his elders in the Sinbound, including Minfilia, Ran'jit fought against the aether-suffused beasts until the day the unit hunted down the Kholusian Lightwarden in the Duergar Mountains. Believing that killing the beast would return night to the land, Zal'bard landed the killing blow on the creature, only to be overtaken by the Light within it and becoming the Lightwarden himself, leaving the Sinbound no recourse but to retreat.

Ran'jit became the leader of Sinbound, working under the strategies of Minfilia, with their goal being for Minfilia to slay the new Lightwarden, using her immunity to the sin eaters' corrupting influence to counteract this curse. This did not come to pass, and ten years after the founding of the Sinbound, Minfilia fell in battle. With her dying breath, she prophesied the coming of another Minfilia, the Oracle of Light. Ran'jit carried her remains to Eulmore to be interred.
